analysis.summary: Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported a 53.3% YoY revenue increase to ₹472.2 crores for Q1 FY27, with EBITDA growing 44.5% to ₹92.3 crores. The company is currently executing a ₹200 crore capacity expansion to increase production from 75,000 MTPA to 100,000 MTPA. Management expects to achieve optimal utilization of this expanded capacity by the end of FY28. The company maintains a debt-free balance sheet and continues to focus on import substitution and specialty polymer growth. Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported its financial performance for Q4 FY26 and the full year FY26, noting a decrease in annual revenue while maintaining robust operational metrics and profitability margins.

guidance.claim: The company expects to reach optimal utilization of its expanded capacity by the end of FY28.
guidance.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand for ABS is expected to be driven by growth in consumer durables and automotive industries.
demand_outlook.quote: Robust growth in end-user industries like consumer durables (air conditioners, refrigerators) and automotive will drive the domestic demand for ABS.

demand_outlook.claim: Appliances and Automotive continue to dominate global demand for ABS resins due to their high impact resistance and aesthetic versatility.
demand_outlook.quote: Appliances and Automotive continue to dominate global demand for ABS resins due to their high impact resistance and aesthetic versatility.

demand_outlook.claim: EV adoption is accelerating consumption as manufacturers prioritize lightweight, high-performance plastics for interior trims and battery housings.
demand_outlook.quote: EV (Electric Vehicle) adoption is accelerating consumption as manufacturers prioritize lightweight, high-performance plastics for interior trims and battery housings.

demand_outlook.claim: The global market is shifting toward specialty and colored grades, moving away from commoditized transparent resins to higher-margin applications.
demand_outlook.quote: The global market is shifting toward specialty & colored grades, moving away from commoditized transparent resins to higher-margin applications.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 was 19.2% compared to 20.0% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 44.5% YoY in Q1 FY27 to ₹ 92.3 crores, from ₹ 63.9 crores in Q1 FY26, with margins at 19.2% for Q1 FY27 as compared to 20.0% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 FY26 EBITDA increased by 33.1% YoY to INR 74.3 crores with margins at 21.8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 33.1% YoY in Q4 FY26 to INR 74.3 crores, with margins at 21.8%; for FY26, EBITDA grew by 1.3% to INR 255.2 crores, with margins at 20.0%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates two manufacturing facilities at Abu Road and Satnoor.
orders_capacity.quote: Operates two manufacturing facilities at Abu Road (Rajasthan) and Satnoor (Madhya Pradesh), supported by an in-house R&D centre at Abu Road.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a debt-free balance sheet.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt-free balance sheet ensures zero financial risk and high resilience.

management_commitments.claim: Optimal utilization of the expanded capacity is expected by the end of FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.
